chunks: Then check their activities, and send spies from among the truthful and faithful to monitor them, for your watching their affairs secretly is an urge for them to practice trustworthiness and gentleness with the subjects.
ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali advise governors to ensure accountability and integrity among their officials?
ai.summary: Imam Ali instructs Malik al-Ashtar to deploy discreet, trustworthy agents to monitor officials, a practice rooted in the Shia understanding of 'hisbah' (accountability) to ensure administrative integrity. This secret surveillance serves as a psychological motivator, encouraging subordinates to uphold *amanah* (trustworthiness) and exercise *rifq* (gentleness) toward the populace, reflecting the ideal of the just ruler who is ever-watchful yet merciful.
